rules.rule_definition: Trader may place a protective exit using extrema of three through five completed price bars, with a separately confirmed fractal alternative.
rules.preconditions: Only completed bars; confirm exchange stop and ownership; no post-hoc candle selection.
rules.confirmation: Closed bar and exact native tick; no stop worsening.
rules.known_at: After last required H1 bar close.
unresolved_ambiguities: Contemporaneous figure interpretation and full execution chain not certified.

rules.rule_definition: Trader may select a four-completed-price-bar alternative within the TC2 3-to-5 bar protective-exit family; no unique automatic selector is prescribed.
rules.preconditions: Exchange-confirmed protected campaign; valid closed post-entry bars; exact native price grid.
rules.confirmation: Four closed consecutive H1 bars and exchange-side STOP confirmation remain separately required.
rules.known_at: At closure of the fourth H1 bar; never at candle opening.
rules.allowed_action: Tighten, never widen, an existing protected campaign STOP after signed Binance proof.
unresolved_ambiguities: Automatic 3/4/5 selector thresholds are ENGINEERING_SAFETY, not book-canonical.
No full signed Demo 4-bar replacement proven.
